title: Delivery pulled forward, feasible only because the thread says fabric is in-house
subject: Re: PKC-6083 earlier ex-factory?
body:
Hi Karthik,

Great news that the fabric is already in-house (your note below). In that case, can we move the ex-factory for PKC-6083 up to 4th January 2027 instead of 20th January? Quantities unchanged.

Thanks,
Nadia
Pinecrest Kids Co.

> On 1 Dec 2026, Karthik <karthik@srivelanknits.example> wrote:
> Hi Nadia, fabric for PKC-6083 has been in-house since 28 Nov and cutting starts next week. Ex-factory 20 Jan 2027 is comfortable.
